## File: huggingface_optimum-executorch/install_dev.py

Prompts

```
['run the install_dev script to install optimum-executorch in dev mode with nightly dependencies', 'run the install_dev script with --skip_override_torch to skip nightly torch dependency installation', 'install nightly executorch, torch, torchvision, torchaudio, and torchao packages from the PyTorch CPU nightly index', 'install transformers and pytorch-tokenizers from their pinned git source commits', 'review the install_dev script to understand the dependency installation order and nightly version pins']
```

Usage

```
{'run_install_dev': 'run the install_dev script to install optimum-executorch in dev mode with nightly dependencies', 'run_install_dev_skip_torch': 'run the install_dev script with --skip_override_torch to skip nightly torch dependency installation', 'install_torch_nightly_deps': 'install nightly executorch, torch, torchvision, torchaudio, and torchao packages from the PyTorch CPU nightly index', 'install_dep_from_source': 'install transformers and pytorch-tokenizers from their pinned git source commits', 'review_install_dev': 'review the install_dev script to understand the dependency installation order and nightly version pins'}
```
